title: Kinsta Review 2026: Pricing, Speed and Who Should Pay for It
excerpt: Kinsta starts at $35 a month for one WordPress site and renews at the same price. Here is what each plan includes, how fast it tested, what the first month free offer is worth and who should pay for it.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Kinsta Review 2026: Pricing, Speed and Who Should Pay for It
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Kinsta review for 2026: plan prices, WordPress features, speed, support and who should pay for managed WordPress hosting, with a short setup guide.
meta.rl_answer: Kinsta is premium managed WordPress hosting from $35 a month for one site, with no renewal jump and no phone support. The first month is free for new customers until 1 December 2026.
meta.rl_faqs:
What is Kinsta hosting? | Kinsta is premium managed WordPress hosting. It runs the server, security, backups and support, and you manage the site in its MyKinsta dashboard. Its managed plans are for WordPress.
Is Kinsta shared hosting? | No. Kinsta is managed WordPress hosting. WP Umbrella says every site runs in its own container, with no shared IP pools, which is different from shared hosting.
How much does Kinsta cost? | The entry plan is $35 a month for one WordPress site, 10 GB of storage and about 35,000 visits. WP 2 is $70 for two sites. Larger Single plans run from $50 to $375 a month. Annual billing saves about two months.
Does Kinsta cost more at renewal? | No. After the first month free and 3 months at half price, the entry plan renews at $35, the same list price. There is no first-term discount that expires.
Why is Kinsta so expensive? | The price pays for management, support and included tools, not raw hardware. WPThinker compares its $35 plan (1 site, 10 GB) with a $14 Cloudways server (25 GB, many sites). EXPERTE ranked its entry plan second most expensive of 14 hosts.
Does Kinsta have a free month or a money-back guarantee? | New customers get the first month free on select plans until 1 December 2026. Kinsta lists a 30-day money-back guarantee that starts after the free period.
Is Kinsta good for WooCommerce? | Yes on the right plan. WPThinker says Kinsta does not recommend the cheapest Single plan for stores and points to Single 65k at $50 or larger.
Is Kinsta fast? | Yes in independent tests. EXPERTE measured a 0.232 s time to first byte, 3rd of 14 hosts, and Webhostingcat measured 77 ms. Hostingstep found WP Engine and Cloudways slightly faster on one run.
Does Kinsta have phone support? | No. Kinsta lists 24/7 human support in 8 languages by chat. There is no phone line.
Does Kinsta include email or a domain? | No. Kinsta does not list email hosting or domain registration. You buy those elsewhere.
Does Kinsta host my FTP files? | Kinsta gives you SFTP and SSH access to your site files, according to reviewers, and it migrates your existing site for free. Check Kinsta's documents for the access details of your plan.
Does Kinsta support Drupal or Magento hosting? | Kinsta's managed hosting plans are for WordPress only, according to CuratorBits. WPThinker notes that Kinsta sells separate application and database hosting. Check Kinsta's documents for other platforms.
Is Kinsta better than Cloudways? | Kinsta costs more and manages more. Cloudways costs less and gives more server control. Both have no renewal jump and no phone support. Compare them at your own traffic.

meta.rl_takeaways:
The entry plan is $35 a month for one WordPress site and renews at $35 (Kinsta, 20 Nov 2026).
The first month is free for new customers until 1 Dec 2026, then 50% off for 3 months.
EXPERTE measured a 0.232 s first response and the fewest slow responses of 14 hosts.
Support is chat only, with no phone line, and there is no email or domain.
meta.rl_r_verdict: Kinsta is worth the price for a WordPress site that earns money or runs a business and needs to be managed, fast and steady. It is not worth it for a hobby site. Use the first month free and the 30-day guarantee to test it.
meta.rl_r_buy:
Your WordPress site runs a business or earns money.
You want WordPress fully managed, with fast support.
You want no renewal price jump.
meta.rl_r_skip:
You have a first or hobby site with small traffic.
You want email or a domain bundled.
You want the lowest price or phone support.
meta.rl_r_pros:
Fully managed WordPress with a clear dashboard.
Fast, consistent results in independent tests.
No renewal price jump.
Free, unlimited migrations and free malware removal.
Daily backups, staging and Cloudflare security on every plan.
meta.rl_r_cons:
A high price for one site and 10 GB.
Overage fees and pricey add-ons such as Redis.
No email, no domain and no phone support.
One site per Single plan.
Managed plans are for WordPress only.
meta.rl_r_best: Business WordPress sites that want everything managed
meta.rl_r_method:
Our own use | We do not host our own site on Kinsta, so this is a research-based review. We did not run our own tests
Pricing and offers | Kinsta's first-month-free page and plans page, read on 20 November 2026, checked against WPThinker (4 November 2026) and CuratorBits (22 October 2026)
Independent tests | EXPERTE (updated August 2026), Webhostingcat (October 2026), WP Umbrella (June 2026) and Hostingstep (April 2026)
Competitor reviews | The top-ranking Kinsta reviews read for structure and questions: WPThinker, CuratorBits, EXPERTE, Themify and CloudPipelines
Questions people ask | The questions the top pages answer in their headings, plus the questions people search for in Semrush, such as why Kinsta is expensive and whether it is shared hosting
When sources disagree | We show both views and say which we used. For plan prices we used Kinsta's own pages
Our calculations | The first-year offer table is our own arithmetic from Kinsta's prices
Freshness | Prices and offers are read again before this page goes live, and the page carries the date they were checked
What we did not do | We did not run our own speed or uptime test. Each test number is credited to the team that measured it
meta.rl_r_plans:
Single 35k (or Single 20GB) | $35 a month | 1 site, 10 GB, about 35,000 visits. Renews at $35 a month.
Single 65k | $50 a month | 1 site, 10 GB, 65,000 visits. Recommended for stores.
WP 2 | $70 a month | 2 sites, 20 GB, 70,000 visits. Renews at $70 a month.
meta.rl_r_alts:
Cloudways | Managed cloud servers | From $11 a month | 5-day free trial | /cloudways-hosting/

meta.rl_r_endsub: Pick a plan, use the first month free before 1 December 2026 and the 30-day money-back guarantee after it to test speed and support.
meta.rl_r_final: Kinsta gives a business WordPress site managed speed and support at a premium price with no renewal jump. Use the free month to test it, and choose Single 65k or larger for a store.
